baseline_architecture.dropout: 0.0 initially; consider <=0.1 only after overfitting evidence
baseline_architecture.implementation_preference: MONAI UNet or transparent project wrapper around MONAI modules
baseline_architecture.parameter_count_estimate: approximately 5-10 million parameters; confirm after implementation
baseline_architecture.upsampling: transposed convolution or MONAI U-Net decoder upsampling
baseline_architecture.weight_initialization: Kaiming-compatible framework default or explicit Kaiming normal

environment_inspection.cpu: 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-1165G7 @ 2.80GHz; 4 cores / 8 logical processors

fallback_framework: reduced 2D or 2.5D PyTorch baseline if GPU memory is insufficient
frozen_test_policy: test set remains inaccessible until model/checkpoint selection is complete

loss_and_optimization.batch_size: start 1; try 2 only if GPU memory permits
loss_and_optimization.checkpoint_selection_metric: best validation macro foreground Dice; never test performance
loss_and_optimization.dice_background_for_optimization: exclude background from Dice term; report background separately
loss_and_optimization.lr_schedule: ReduceLROnPlateau on validation macro foreground Dice or conservative cosine schedule after smoke testing
loss_and_optimization.mixed_precision: enabled on CUDA after smoke test; disabled on CPU

official_sources.topic: PyTorch local install and support matrix
official_sources.used_for: Python support, Windows support, CUDA/CPU choices, CUDA availability verification.
Pinned PyTorch 2.6.0 CUDA 12.4 and CPU wheel availability.
MONAI relationship to PyTorch/CUDA and optional imaging extras.

proposed_dependency_versions.cuda_build: cu124 for NVIDIA CUDA training environment; CPU build only for dependency smoke checks

recommended_execution_environment.current_windows_cpu_only_machine: dependency verification, documentation, and very small CPU shape tests only; not practical for full 3D training
recommended_execution_environment.minimum_gpu_smoke_test_tier: 8-12 GB VRAM for smoke tests at batch size 1; actual feasibility unverified
recommended_execution_environment.preferred: separate NVIDIA GPU environment, preferably institutional/university GPU or approved local/cloud GPU with CUDA-compatible driver
recommended_execution_environment.preferred_baseline_training_tier: 16-24 GB VRAM for 96^3 patches, 63 logits, AMP, batch size 1-2 or gradient accumulation
recommended_execution_environment.verification_requirement: memory estimates must be confirmed by a real GPU smoke test

validation_inference.blending: Gaussian when supported, otherwise constant averaging
